what_happened: A job to link the producer's CARGO_TARGET_DIR to the held slot's shared warm build folder was interrupted on 6 Nov. Its retry was rejected on 7 Nov because its tests broke a rule, and no clean-up followed. Nothing picked it up afterward, so writers still build into private folders of 12 to 15 GB per job. Sri noticed the stale item on the status page, although on 8 Nov he had asked that paused and failed work be followed through. The the person running Athena reported it instead of re-queuing it by hand.
cause: Athena has no standing step that revisits failed, rejected or interrupted jobs whose goal is still wanted. A rejection ends the job's lifecycle and nothing connects it back to the open goal. The owner's instruction to follow through lived only as a message, not as a rule or a scheduled duty. Staleness showed only on a page a person happened to read.
prevention: Add a follow-through duty that runs on a schedule inside the steward's loop. It lists every job whose last state is interrupted, rejected or failed and whose goal has no landed or queued successor. For each one it queues a retry that carries the original goal plus the rejection finding, or it records a reasoned close. The status page also shows the age of each such item. This covers the whole class, not only this job.
proposed_request: Add a scheduled follow-through step to the steward's loop. Each cycle it finds jobs that were interrupted, rejected or failed and have no landed or queued successor for the same goal. For each one it either queues a retry that keeps the original request goal and adds the last rejection finding, or it records a reason for closing it. Acceptance: (1) given records with an interrupted job and a later rejected retry and no successor, one cycle queues exactly one retry carrying the original goal and the rejection finding; (2) a second cycle queues no duplicate; (3) a job with a queued or landed successor is skipped; (4) the status page shows the age of any unresolved item. Then retry 'Link producer CARGO_TARGET_DIR to the held slot's target' (job 20261106-202436-ch54), with the test rule that broke on 7 Nov fixed, so producers share the held slot's warm build folder instead of building into private 12 to 15 GB folders.
